reasons.name: AssetNotListed
reasons.rule: an asset is not on the platform list

reasons.name: DuplicateAsset
reasons.rule: an asset appears more than once

reasons.name: WeightOffStep
reasons.rule: a weight is not a multiple of stepBps

reasons.name: WeightAboveCeiling
reasons.rule: a weight is over min(maxWeightBps, the asset's ceiling)

reasons.name: WeightSum
reasons.rule: the weights do not add up to sumBps

reasons.name: VersionPending
reasons.rule: a version is published and not yet in effect

reasons.name: TurnoverTooHigh
reasons.rule: the absolute weight changes against the previous version add up to more than twice maxTurnoverBps

reasons.name: CashNotAllowed
reasons.rule: the chain's cash token is a component
